why_this_paper_matters: This paper identifies mitochondrial dysfunction as a central mechanism in nanoplastic-induced renal inflammation and senescence, providing a therapeutic target via PGC1α activation for mitigating kidney damage from nanoplastic exposure. The mechanistic dissociation between inflammation and senescence offers insights into the complex pathophysiology of nanoplastic toxicity in the kidney, with potential applications in environmental health and regenerative medicine.
